Maya: FYI I opened a micro PR to polish SDK snippets after the stream/pager rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523

Ethan: taking a look. main changes I expect: stream is async iterable, pager exposes PageToken, and retries via max_retries.

Priya: tiny checklist I added in PR: python async snippet, TS for-await example, go pager resume note, and link fixes.

Maya: Python snippet I left in the PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
async for chunk in client.stream("gpt-small", prompt="summarize", max_retries=2):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Ethan: TS example uses for-await and is copy-paste ready. docs-bot flagged one broken anchor in ts/pager.md and fixed it.

Jonah: Go pager comment added: use opts.PageToken = pager.PageToken() to resume. Also note SDK applies retries by default.

docs-bot: CI for PR 523 1: pass. Auto-linker updated internal anchor.

Maya: Can @Ethan drop a one-liner in the PR about default max_retries=3 and recommended override for latency-sensitive endpoints?

Ethan: done.

Priya: LGTM

Maya: thanks all 1 merging if CI stays green.
